ModMetaData.name: Psychology Resurrected
ModMetaData.author: tk421storm
ModMetaData.description: Psychology Resurrected continues The Word-Mule's Psychology for RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7. Every pawn gets a persistent personality, opinions form through real conversations, and romance, mental breaks and mental illness all follow from who a pawn is. This update requires a new save. Mayors and elections, and Psychology's own funerals, have been removed. Replace "Psychology (unofficial)" with this mod; don't run both. Psyche Every pawn has a personality, separate from traits, shown in the Psyche tab with a word cloud and a Big Five summary. It shapes their conversations, friendships, romance, mental breaks and how they take to their ideoligion. Social Pawns hold conversations on many topics and form opinions from them, drifting toward like-minded people and away from those they disagree with. Friends hang out in their free time. Romance and dating Sexuality is graded on the Kinsey scale, with separate sex and romantic drives. Couples plan date nights, and compatible singles ask each other out on courtship dates. On a date, pawns do things together: games, walks, skygazing, reading, music and dancing, sharing a meal, or showing off a passion while the other watches and learns. Both rate the date afterwards, and a date that went well can lead to romance. Vanilla romance attempts go through Psychology, and pawns at parties or relaxing socially may try their luck. Pawns have a family drive, and couples choose their approach to pregnancy. Mental illness and treatment Pawns can develop anxiety, or acquire it as PTSD after a stressful break, and need treatment to keep it in check. Problem traits like chemical interest and pyromania can be treated, and methadone helps manage addiction. Growing up A child's personality shapes which traits and passions their growth moments offer. Compatibility Works with Character Editor, Prepare Carefully, Vanilla Psycasts Expanded, Vanilla Traits Expanded, Intimacy, Romance on the Rim, No Hopeless Romance, Less Stupid Romance Attempt, Romance Tweaks, Humanoid Alien Races and Pawnmorpher. Not compatible with Way Better Romance or Rational Romance (1 and 2), which overhaul the same romance systems, or with 1-2-3 Personalities and Rimpsyche, which add a second personality system. This release also fixes a long list of bugs the mod carried. The full changelog is on GitHub. Credits Original mod by The Word-Mule. Kept alive as Psychology (unofficial) by che_lovek and WILDCARD; 1.1 patching by Nationality; fixes for 1.1-1.3 by KEMPER; the 1.3/1.4 rework by eebasso with WILDCARD and KEMPER. Hug idea from Personality Plus. Idea for passionate work mood bonus by ({x}) Disarray. Ideas for many of the mental breaks by twoski. Name of the Socialite trait by Wellech. Translators: Russian by Паулк, German by Chaos, Chinese by Mr.Gha, French by Éloïse Rodrake. Psychology Resurrected by tk421storm.
